text:
Priya (docs): Hi all, opening a focused PR to tidy the Quickstart 'Hello World' onboarding: modernize snippets to SDK v7, unify auth examples (dev-portal + CLI), and add a short instructor checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/980 — please sanity-check code examples and the instructor note about Node version.

Omar (eng): I'll scan snippets. Quick question: do we default to the responses API in examples or keep chat.* calls?

Priya (docs): Default to responses.generate in the main flow, but include a tiny side bar mapping chat.* -> responses.generate for compatibility.

Tess (devex): I'll update the quickstart generator templates afterward. Reminder: generator uses single-quote style; examples should match to avoid lint churn.

Riley (qa): I'll run the sample container. Paste the minimal run commands and expected smoke result?

Priya (docs): From the PR description: 
```
# build and run
docker build -t rw-hello:latest .
docker run -e RW_API_KEY=sk_test_... -p 3000:3000 rw-hello:latest
# smoke
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/hello | jq .  # -> {"message":"Hello, Redwood!"}
```
We also document the dev-portal flow with RW_DEV_PORTAL=true and the CLI token flow in an Appendix.

Omar (eng): Found one leftover: examples/hello/server.js uses `client.chat.completions.create()` — will replace with `await client.responses.generate({ model: 'rw-small', input: prompt })`. Also switching Docker base to `node:20-alpine` for the sample.

Ken (pm): Please add a short migration table mapping old env names: RW_TOKEN -> RW_API_KEY, and note for instructors about Node 18 vs Node 20 differences.

Priya (docs): Done — added migration table and an "Instructor checklist" at the top: node version, required envs, common failure modes.

Tess (devex): Pushed a generator patch and fixed a linting newline. ci-bot: will kick off preview.

ci-bot: CI started for docs/quickstart-cleanup-980  build 7421 queued.

Riley (qa): Quick run found the app errors when RW_DEV_PORTAL=true but REDWOOD_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID is missing. Suggest adding a friendly error page and documenting required redirect URL.

Omar (eng): Good call — wrapping callback handler to validate envs and returning a helpful 400 + doc link. Will push.

ci-bot: build 7421 failed in examples-lint (trailing comma in examples/hello/app.js).

Priya (docs): Fixed the trailing comma and clarified wording around the dev-portal redirect URI.

ci-bot: build 7422 passed  deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-980.redwood.dev

Ken (pm): Preview looks fine. One tiny wording nit in the instructor checklist: change "ensure port 3000 free" -> "ensure localhost:3000 is available".

Priya (docs): Updated wording and merging in the afternoon unless anyone objects. Thanks for the quick turn-around! :sparkles:
